simple.meaning: נִשֵּׂאת (nissêʼth) is a Hebrew action word meaning “something taken , i.e. a present.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in 2 Samuel, beginning at 2 Samuel 19:43. The surrounding contexts include kingship, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נִשֵּׂאת (H5379) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: נִשֵּׂאת (nissêʼth) / H5379 is traced through 2 Samuel 19:43 with source-language evidence and verse context.

firstOccurrence.englishText: The men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, “We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more claim to David than you. Why then did you despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king?” The words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.
